page.overview:
Who is Bogard?

Bogard is a Marine Headquarters Marine officer and the right hand man of Vice Admiral Monkey D. Garp.

Bogard is a tall man, standing roughly half a head higher than Monkey D. Garp. He has short brown hair. A Marine coat is draped loosely over his shoulders. Beneath it, he wears a double-breasted beige suit, with a dark brown tie and a light green collared shirt. A beige wide-brimmed fedora rests upon his head, the brim casting a shadow across his eyes.

At his left hip, he carries a katana, attached to his belt with a brown strap. The sword has a grey-wrapped hilt, a golden cross-shaped tsuba with rounded edges, and a deep green sheath.

Bogard seems to wear an apparently perpetual scowl on his face, the corners of his mouth always pointing downwards, even as a young Marine, emphasizing his air of seriousness. On the rare occasions he smiles, it appears more like a smirk.
